MOBILE | MOBILE-GUI-STITCH-20261116 | Scope: mobile GUI in this Stitch project only. This is part 2 of Nawader camel-classified mobile GUI. Build ALL TEN individually named MOBILE screens below, each its own screen not collage. LIGHT MODE ONLY for this batch; responsive dark mode will be integrated into exported HTML separately. Follow project DESIGN.md and exact SOURCE palette: background #F8F3EA surface #FFFCF8 primary #A77434 text #2D241B border #E4D5C0. Noto Sans Arabic, Arabic RTL, 18px body,20px bold button labels,56px primary buttons,48px tap targets,20px margins. SIMPLE functional app, NOT marketing. Older and low technology familiarity users: concise short labels, one primary action, clear back, minimal boxes and badges. No invented support phone, no official market claims, no payments/bidding/verified purchases. Main screen bottom tabs RTL الرئيسية/المفضلة/أضف إعلان/الرسائل/حسابي. Use authentic logo placeholder (bitmap will be embedded), not a drawn camel substitute. Every consent is initially UNCHECKED, no phone confirmation equals identity. Use sample fictional data only. Requirements AD-FR-034, AD-NFR-001, 005, 009.
H01 — توثيق الحساب: Distinct identity via trusted provider and business via private documents, optional service, no phone=identity.
H02 — توثيق الهوية: Consent and provider handoff, waiting/failed/provider unavailable recoverable, no client success badge.
H03 — توثيق النشاط: Private document picker progress/retry, no public document exposure, draft/submit and explicit consent.
H04 — حالة طلب التوثيق: Submitted/checking/approved/rejected/expired/cancelled readable timeline; reasons and resubmit where allowed, type-specific badge only trusted approval.
H05 — التحميل وإعادة المحاولة: Skeleton with readable loading, network error retry and retain inputs; no false success.
H06 — أنت غير متصل: Offline saved draft local notice, reconnect/retry, no submitted success, preserved inputs.
H07 — قائمة فارغة: No favorites/messages/ads empty variants with useful relevant CTA, simple illustrations.
H08 — الحساب موقوف: Clear access limitation, account owner appropriate reason, support/help, no publish/bump, no private info leaked.
H09 — صلاحيات الصور والموقع والتنبيهات: Just in time permission rationale, denied fallback including manual location/gallery/settings, no forced all-permissions gate.
H10 — تأكيد النجاح أو فشل الحفظ: Distinct saving/success/failure inline status, server confirmation required, retry no duplicate submit.
Generate all10 screens now, each title prefixed with ID exactly.
